purpose.summary: This is a GnuCOBOL binding/connector library for the Agar GUI toolkit, providing COBOL-accessible constants, data structures, and callable wrappers for Agar GUI objects (windows, buttons, labels, combos, menus, graphs, etc.). It defines flag constants, widget instance layouts, and likely CALL interfaces to the underlying C Agar library. The program is recursive, suggesting it may dispatch GUI events or callbacks.

verdict.notes: The file is a GnuCOBOL FFI wrapper for the Agar cross-platform GUI library. Struct offsets are hardcoded (pic x(712) fillers) to match the C layout, with commented-out variants for Linux vs Windows debug builds, indicating real portability work. The truncated source shows only the DATA DIVISION constants; the PROCEDURE DIVISION with 117 CALLs and 152 PERFORMs is present but not shown in the excerpt.
